Treating Layer 3 as a rename target for a canonical architectural term implies it is an existing architectural entity. This is a strong claim (that Layer 3 has a defined, renameable identity) without role-matched citation, AND it conflicts with the documentation-established not-built status. CLAUDE.md §10 forbids claiming Layer 3 is implemented without proof.

Layer 3 as a named layer may be defined architecturally even if unbuilt, but the rename implies canonical identity — which requires explicit SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_AND_BUILD_SEQUENCE_v1.md citation. Conflict between architectural-planning identity and not-yet-built status must be resolved, not assumed away.
